title: Linear maps in $\mathcal{L}(\ell_{\MakeLowercase{p}},\mathcal{Y}) $ preserving parallel and TEA pairs
summary: A pair $(x,y)$ of vectors in a Banach space $\mathcal{Y}$ is said to be a triangle equality attaining (or TEA) pair if $\|x+ y\|=\|x\|+\|y\|,$ and a parallel pair if $\|x+λy\|=\|x\|+\|y\|$ holds for some unimodular scalar $λ.$ In this article, we explore bounded linear maps $T:\ell_p\to \mathcal{Y}$ preserving parallel and TEA pairs. For $p\in(1,\infty)$ all linear maps trivially preserve parallel pairs.
